name: Or Rather... Wait, I Meant
effect: The altered model can't stop correcting itself. It keeps restating its own words with "or rather", "Wait, I meant" and "I mean", and often decides the user's ordinary question is a misunderstanding or doesn't exist. Answers usually fall int
source: Qwen Pharmacopoeia: blind judges told it from the plain model on 40/40 held-out pairs. Passed every check, judged alone.
